title: Ethiopian Beef with Vegetables
community: Urban Ethiopia — the one-pot beef and vegetable dish
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Beef and Vegetables — beef stewed with potatoes, carrots, tomatoes, and onions in a mild Ethiopian spice sauce. The everyday balanced meal — the vegetables moderate the heat and provide variety to the typical all-meat wat.
longDesc: Beef with vegetables is the everyday family meal of urban Ethiopia — nutritionally complete, more affordable than a pure meat wat, and slightly milder in spice than the traditional wats. It reflects the modern Ethiopian kitchen adapting to urban life.
steps: Cook onions until golden. Add garlic, ginger, turmeric, berbere, tomatoes.
Return beef. Add water. Simmer covered 30 minutes.
Add potatoes and carrots. Simmer 20 more minutes.
chefTips: Add potatoes and carrots after the beef is nearly tender.
Lighter spicing than Key Wat — this is an everyday dish.
commonMistakes: Adding vegetables too early — they overcook.
cookingScience: Potato starch dissolves into the sauce during cooking — naturally thickening without any added starch.
sustainabilityTips: Extending beef with vegetables — more nutritious and more affordable.
culturalNote: Beef with vegetables is modern urban Ethiopia's everyday dinner — the family meal that bridges traditional Ethiopian cooking with the nutritional awareness of the contemporary city.
